annotations.variable_note: GNMA securitizes more than 90 percent of FHA’s MMI loan guarantees and 98 percent of VA’s loan guarantees, resulting in additional offsetting collections. The subsidy rate for GNMA, which is calculated using FCRA methods, is estimated to be -0.34 percent in 2023, -0.32 percent in 2024, and -0.34 percent annually over the 2025-2033 period.
